title.p: Chapter 1150: Im actually an expert counterfeiter (3)

section.p: “Of course. Those things are durable enough to even bear the power of Invincibles. They can naturally bear the weight of a small space as well. Each treasure is much more durable than a character. Don’t you know that only the most durable of treasures can bear the weight of the past and future bodies?”

Zhu Tiandao added, “But these treasures are too rare. There are only a limited number of them in existence, and most of them are already in the hands of Invincibles and peak Sunmoons. I doubt Great Xia has any to spare. The ones they actually have would be given to Xia Longwu instead. Also, forget about me. In Great Ming, someone needs those treasures as well. But we can’t provide even one.”

He was referring to Niu Baidao. That old man lacked a carrier treasure to further his cultivation. He only had one, and that had been used to bear one of his tri-life bodies. He needed another to carry the second body. And he needed something sufficiently powerful for that. Even now, Old Niu was still in the Allheaven Battlefield, searching for a suitable treasure.
As for the Human Realm as a whole, these treasures were also extremely rare. After all, humanity had produced too many Invincibles during that period over three hundred years ago.

“Most Invincible ruins come with these treasures as well. That’s one of the reasons these ruins are so valued. A ruin without a carrier treasure will not be qualified to be called an Invincible ruin.”
Understanding dawned on Su Yu. His heart started aching. He only had two of them. Was he supposed to use them for this plan? Wait, this was Xia Family’s plan. Why should he bear such a cost for it?

If something unexpected happened and the treasures were lost, wouldn’t his loss be massive? When counterfeiting, Su Yu was quite generous. If this was his own plan, he would definitely be willing to invest more. But this was not even his own plan.
Feeling helpless, Su Yu asked, “Prefect, so we only need to throw a carrier treasure inside?”

“Of course not. Strengthening space instantly is not an easy task. If you’re willing to spend, think of a way to crush a carrier treasure and fuse it with the grotto. If you’re rich enough, you can crush two carrier treasures. That way, nobody will doubt the ruin is fake anymore.”

Zhu Tiandao teased, “You’re rich so maybe you can consider this option. You can place two in the fake ruin to show that they are meant for dao affirmation. Then, you can use one more to strengthen space. All in all, you only need to spare three carrier treasures for this. At that time, not even Invincibles would doubt the authenticity of this ruin anymore. Only a fool will use three carrier treasures to create a fake ruin. After all, humanity can probably produce one more Invincible with these carrier treasures. We actually have a large number of peak Sunmoons stuck because of a lack of carrier treasures…”
Was that the case? Understanding dawned on Su Yu. The price to fool even Invincibles would absolutely not be cheap. After investing three carrier treasures, he would be able to fool everyone.

Breaking one to strengthen space and placing two inside for one to affirm one’s dao. Including other treasures they were planning to plant inside the fake ruin, it would practically turn into a real ruin.

For example, heavenly source qi could be used to forge one’s body. As for the sunmoon profound yellow liquid, it could be used to strengthen one’s apertures. Finally, the carrier treasures could be used to complete the dao affirmation.

Right, if he could add some nine transformation treasures, it would be even better. Including the powerful cultivation methods they were going to plant inside the fake ruin, as long as one was talented enough, one could totally reach the Invincible Realm there. Was that how a regular Invincible ruin would look like?
“But I only have two carrier treasures…”

Su Yu muttered to himself. One was the dragon pearl while the other was the heavenly profound iron. Suddenly, he recalled the dragon’s horn case he had. Was there a carrier treasure in it? If the answer was yes, he would have three carrier treasures.

Since the sect master placed such heavy importance on it, that might actually be something he prepared for his future dao affirmation. At that thought, Su Yu started flying toward the capital. He had to meet the Xia Family…no, scratch that. They were too unprofessional. He should look for Wan Tiansheng instead.

It was too dangerous to work with the Xia Family. They were too poor to even counterfeit properly. They had to be willing to invest if they wanted good results. If they were successful with the plan, they wouldn’t even lose that much. After all, everything they invested into the fake ruin could be retrieved.

Of course, they would suffer a massive loss if they failed to retrieve what they invested. Su Yu braced himself to invest most of what he had earned during his time in the Allheaven Battlefield. If he succeeded, he could potentially earn even more than what he invested. After all, the corpse of an Invincible would be very valuable, right?

Also, an Invincible would probably have a heaven weapon in possession, right? Furthermore, that traitor Invincible seemed to have a lot of Sunmoon characters. Great riches were always accompanied by great danger.

Su Yu was prepared to lose massively from this. He only hoped to make everything more believable. Perhaps the Xia Family was really too poor, resulting in the creation of a fake ruin that was quite obviously fake. But they were going to bet their lives on this plan as well. This was not a game.

And among the lives being bet, some belonged to people Su Yu was not willing to lose. For example, people like Hong Tan and Bai Feng. Su Yu did not want to see something happen to them because of a minor loophole in the plan.
Wealth? He could always scam or rob if he needed more.
Heart Cultivating Pavilion.

When Su Yu took out a large amount of sunmoon profound yellow liquid, two carrier treasures, over a thousand portions of heavenly source qi, and some other precious treasures such as celestial devil fruits, Wan Tiansheng’s eyes turned slightly red.
“Su Yu…why don’t we…give up on the plan? These things are actually enough for a regular person to cultivate until the Invincible Realm. Maybe we should give up on the plan?”

Wan Tiansheng was completely stupefied by what he saw. This kid was too generous. And too rich. Holy shit! Was the kid not worried that he would decide to rob these items? Why was the kid showing them all to him?
Yes. Wan Tiansheng was very tempted to rob the kid. These treasures were enough for a regular genius to cultivate smoothly until the Invincible Realm as long as one was talented enough.

Su Yu was too incredibly rich. Wan Tiansheng was somewhat aware of the other treasures the kid had amassed, but he had no idea the kid had gathered even two carrier treasures. These carrier treasures were incredibly valuable and rare.
Soon, Wan Tiansheng concluded that the kid must have picked up these treasures from the tri-life bodies the Invincibles lost in the ancient city previously. The kid was truly too brazen.

Next, Su Yu took a case out and said, “There’s one more in here. The Divine Skywing Sect master placed great importance on it. I believe there must be a carrier treasure in it. The origin of the dragon’s pearl is too obvious so we can crush it to strengthen the grotto. If there is really another carrier treasure in this case, we can use this and the other carrier treasure to act as the gift for the ruin’s inheritor. That way, nobody will suspect our ruin.”

Wan Tiansheng was losing his mind. Suspect? He greatly suspected that this kid was stupid. Who would suspect a ruin with two carrier treasures in it? Great Xia’s history was too short. And it had also lost a lot. Ye Batian and Wan Tiansheng himself had exhausted some of Great Xia’s carrier treasures.

Thus, this was not a level of counterfeiting Great Xia could afford to do. With these treasures, even if they announced the truth, nobody would believe it. If the Xia Family was so rich, they could have produced another Invincible instead of wasting it on a plan like this. Or at the very least, they could have produced another Pseudo Invincible.

In fact, not a single prefecture in the Human Realm would have the ability to produce such a fake ruin. It would only be possible if multiple prefectures worked together. But that was not possible since nobody knew the identity of the traitor.
“You…are very professional in counterfeiting.”
Su Yu nodded proudly, “Of course. I’m a professional counterfeiter. Principal, a proper counterfeit product needs to be as good as the real deal.”

Wan Tiansheng didn’t know what to say. If they were to finish producing this and leave it for a few hundred years, it would actually turn into a real Invincible ruin. It would only need to age a little.

What a generous kid. Then again, this kid was truly reliable when it came to getting the job done. Wan Tiansheng was also aware of the loopholes of this plan, but unfortunately, he was also too poor to do anything.

His thought was to start fighting right after an Invincible arrived. But now, they could probably afford to wait a little. In fact, it would even help them now if an Invincible actually arrived. That Invincible would be helpful in further promoting the fake ruin. No, at this point, that might as well be a real ruin.

Su Yu said, “This is not all. I’m also planning to use the Character Technique Stele and release some character technique undulations. That way, people will link the ruin to the multiple character faction. This will be even more tempting for the traitor. After all, such a ruin might really produce an Invincible in the hands of the multiple character faction. Neither the traitor nor the myriad races can afford to neglect this ruin.”

Wan Tiansheng had nothing to say. Did the kid know that this…might really attract multiple Invincibles from the myriad races? For the very first time, Wan Tiansheng started fearing his own plan. What if he couldn’t withstand the resulting pressure?

Wan Tiansheng felt very helpless. He only wanted to lure the traitor out or maybe get one more Invincible killed on top of that. But this damn kid! This damn kid was so crazy Wan Tiansheng even wondered if the kid was trying to set him up and get him killed!
Linking the ruin to the multiple character faction? Was the kid not worried that the myriad races would go mad and send multiple Invincibles over?
Su Yu seemed to be able to guess Wan Tiansheng’s thoughts. He gnashed his teeth and said, “When things get desperate, you only need to send me to the realm entrance!”
“Hmm?”

Wan Tiansheng thought of something. He looked at the kid again. He said nothing, but he could guess what the kid was thinking. He sighed. Was the kid…planning to involve himself in the battle between Invincibles as well?
